notes: Two separate single structures side by side with no arrow between them, so this is not a scheme. Each carries a printed Latin caption beneath it: Tembotrione on the left, Tefuryltrione on the right. The page is born-digital and every bond and atom label in both structures is crisp; all positions were read off the drawn ring and none was inferred from what the molecule ought to be. The two structures are identical except for the terminal group of the C3 side chain (CH2CF3 on the left, tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethyl on the right). The tetrahydrofuran C2 of the right-hand structure is a stereocentre and is drawn with two plain lines, no wedge and no hash and no configuration label, so the drawing specifies no configuration and the SMILES carries no stereo descriptor. Both are existing commercial herbicides cited in the background section as the products that motivate the work; neither is a step of the invention's route.
